quarterly_data.signal: IES Holdings release (8-K): fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended June 30) revenue was $1,243 million, up 40%, and operating income $178.5 million, up 60%; net income attributable to IES $153.0 million and diluted EPS $7.57. Communications revenue $453.1 million (+51%, primarily data center demand; operating income $83.6 million); Infrastructure Solutions $224.1 million (+73%, custom engineered solutions primarily for the data center end market, with Gulf Island contributing $51.7 million; operating income $53.4 million); Commercial & Industrial $241.4 million (+109%, driven by expanded data-center capabilities; operating income $54.2 million); Residential $324.1 million (-6%). Adjusted EBITDA was $201.3 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 FY2026 revenue $1,243 million (+40%); operating income $178.5 million (+60%)

quarterly_data.signal: IES Holdings release (8-K): backlog reached approximately $4.5 billion at June 30, 2026, up 91% since the end of fiscal 2025, with remaining performance obligations of approximately $2.8 billion; backlog by segment was Communications $1,612.1 million, Commercial & Industrial $1,402.0 million, Infrastructure Solutions $1,129.2 million and Residential $381.8 million.

CEO Matt Simmes (8-K release): Infrastructure Solutions added approximately one million square feet of production capacity over the past year with Gulf Island (January 2026) and production facilities in Abilene, TX (April 2026; 176,000 square feet) and Manitowoc, WI (September 2025), which IES is repositioning and expects to contribute meaningfully from fiscal 2027; Commercial & Industrial is training additional teams to serve the data center end market. Q3 capital expenditures were $44.6 million.
quarterly_data.figure: about one million square feet of production capacity added
